description: Use when an agent must translate text (replies, documents, transcripts). Input: text (max 1500 chars, GET or POST JSON), target language code, optional source (auto-detected for Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Cyrillic, Arabic, Hindi, Thai; Latin script defaults to English). Output: translatedText, source, target, model. Not stored. Example: ?text=Hello%2C%20how%20are%20you%3F&target=ko Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

source.description: Source language (default auto: detected from the script; give it for Latin-script languages other than English)

text.description: Text to translate (1-1500 chars). Empty or longer → 400 before payment (not charged)

name: ai_translate
title: Translate text between 19 languages (Korean, Japanese, Chinese, English, European), source auto-detected by script
